item.title: Lowest ever: DJI Mini 3 drone deal slashes prices by $144
item.description: If you’ve been waiting for the right moment to buy your first drone, or upgrade from an older one, this might be it. The DJI Mini 3 has dropped to its lowest-ever price, and the timing couldn’t be better. With Valentine’s Day around the corner and travel season not far behind, this lightweight flyer is suddenly one of the most tempting tech buys you can make right now. more…

item.title: How to shoot epic ski footage with DJI Osmo 360 camera
item.description: Action cameras are no longer just tools for extreme sports fans; they’re storytelling machines. Osmo 360, which is DJI’s first dedicated 360-degree action camera, is built to capture immersive panoramic footage that can be reframed in post or edited to look like traditional action clips. It boasts native 8K 360° video, 120 MP panoramic stills, dual HDR 1-inch sensors, and up to 4K/120 fps in Single-Lens mode, making it a powerful choice for ski shooters who want cinematic Winter content directly

item.title: A US drone company is running a massive network in China
item.description: A US drone company is running 34 autonomous drone docks across 965 square miles in China, and multiple government agencies are using them at the same time. more…

item.title: Valqari locks major patent for fully autonomous drone delivery
item.description: Chicago-based drone infrastructure startup Valqari has just crossed a major milestone, and this one goes beyond simply receiving drone deliveries. The company announced it has been granted its 17th US patent, and it tackles a long-standing gap in autonomous drone logistics: how drones send packages without human involvement. more…

item.title: How the XAG P150 Max drone helps farms do more, faster
item.description: When labor is tight and timing matters, technology is stepping in to pick up the slack. That’s the reality many US farmers are facing right now, and it’s exactly where the newly available XAG P150 Max agricultural drone is positioning itself as a practical solution. more…

item.title: DJI’s SkyPixel contest shows how far drone storytelling has come
item.description: More than halfway through its run, DJI says its flagship SkyPixel competition is already breaking records. The company and its creative platform SkyPixel have crossed 45,000 global submissions for the 11th annual SkyPixel Photo & Video Contest, signaling just how mainstream — and competitive — aerial storytelling has become. item.title: Corvus Robotics takes inventory drones into the deep freeze
item.description: Warehouses built for frozen food aren’t exactly friendly places for people, or robots. Temperatures plunge well below zero, frost builds up on everything, airflow is constant, and visibility can be a mess. Yet these same environments demand some of the most precise inventory tracking in logistics. item.title: Wisconsin Police deploy drone to catch serial park pooper
item.description: File this one under things you don’t expect drones to be used for, but here we are. A police department in Wisconsin says it used a drone, along with trail cameras, to identify and cite a woman accused of repeatedly defecating in a local public park. And yes, the drone caught the suspect in the act. more…

item.title: California city approves $683K drone program for police emergencies
item.description: The Santa Ana City Council in Orange County, California, has officially approved a new Drone as a First Responder (DFR) program, giving police a faster way to respond to emergencies while placing firm limits on how the technology can be used. more…

item.title: FPV drones show up big at 2026 Winter Olympics
item.description: The first weekend of the 2026 Milan Cortina Winter Olympics is over. Medals have already been awarded, there’s been great success and also some devastating moments. But what has been on my mind all weekend is a certain consistent buzzing noise during almost every downhill run: FPV drones. more…
